name: clientflow-ai
description: ClientFlow AI — WhatsApp Business Automation Platform

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.setup:db: psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE clientflow;" && psql -U postgres -d clientflow -f database/schema.sql && psql -U postgres -d clientflow -f database/seed.sql
